MW2 Unlocker - quick start
==========================

1. Start the game (single player or multiplayer).
2. Double-click MW2Unlocker.exe

   - It waits up to 30 seconds for the game, so you can start it while MW2
     is still loading.
   - If the game runs as administrator, run this program as administrator too.
   - The console window is normal; it reports what happened.

3. That is it. Press F6 in game to switch the tweaks on and off.

The window stays open while you play and closes when the game does.


Settings
--------
unlocker.ini next to this file is the one that gets used. Open it in Notepad:

    [fps]
    value=0

    [fov]
    value=90

    value=0    no frame cap at all (fastest)
    value=250  request a 250 cap - the engine will land near 212
    value=90   field of view, in degrees

Changes take effect next time you start the game and run this program: the
settings are read once, when the tweaks are applied.


Two things worth knowing
------------------------
* The game's own frame limiter is imprecise. It rounds your value down to a
  whole number of milliseconds and then overshoots a little, so a request of
  250 gives about 212, and a request of 167 gives about 190. For an exact
  frame rate, set value=0 here and cap it with your graphics driver (NVIDIA
  Control Panel -> Max Frame Rate) or RTSS instead.

* Multiplayer is VAC-protected. This is intended for single player, private
  matches and offline use. Using anything like this on a secured server can
  get your account banned.


If nothing happens
------------------
A log is written to:

    %LOCALAPPDATA%\MW2Unlocker\mw2_unlocker.log

It names the settings it found, the addresses it wrote to, and anything it
could not find.
